title: Что случилось на самом деле  (What Really Happened)

segments.t: Flashing back to reality, we see that when Alexey Smolin introduced himself as the Michelin inspector, Chef Barinov suffered a sudden stroke and collapsed on the spot before any tasting menu or coconut bet ever took place.
Ну не смотри на меня так.
С вами сейчас всё в порядке?
Шеф, я приведу вас в чувство!
Now let's go back through their conversation line by line and unpack the Russian phrasing.
Ну не смотри на меня так.
'Well, do not look at me like that.' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'come on' before landing on 'so'.
'You must not be overfed so much.' The meaning hinges on 'you' working together with 'to overfeed' in spoken Russian.
'A Michelin inspector has come to see you.' Fedya anchors the line on 'you', while 'Michelin' completes the thought. the inspector answers right away.
'Hello, respected Viktor Petrovich.' Notice how Russian expresses 'hello' and 'esteemed' with crisp inflection rather than helper words.
'My name is Alexey Smolin.' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'me' before landing on 'Smolin'.
'I am inspecting your restaurant today.' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'I' and finishing on 'restaurant'.
С вами сейчас всё в порядке?
'Is everything alright with you right now?' the inspector anchors the line on 'with', while 'order' completes the thought.
'Yes, it is just so unexpected.' The grammar packs 'yes' and 'unexpectedly' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange.
'Hello, it is very nice to meet you.' The meaning hinges on 'hello' working together with 'pleasant' in spoken Russian.
'Call an ambulance here!' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'to call' before landing on 'help'.
Шеф, я приведу вас в чувство!
'Chef, I will bring you to your senses!' Fedya anchors the line on 'Chef Barinov', while 'feeling' completes the thought.
'Stop, do not touch him right now!' The grammar packs 'stop' and 'now' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange. Alright, let's hear the entire conversation one more time from start to finish.
Ну не смотри на меня так.
С вами сейчас всё в порядке?
Шеф, я приведу вас в чувство!
All the wild adventures in the episode were echoes of the real world filtering into Chef Barinov's coma while paramedics tried to revive him. Until next time!
